hosts.footnote: "Referring · Unconfigured" hosts are external domains or IPs that resolve to this proxy but have no matching site configuration. They may represent DNS misconfiguration, health-check scanners, or direct-IP probes. Data is aggregated across all worker processes and persisted to disk — the list survives both traffic spikes and service restarts.
